title: Ask uses Qwen3.8 27B at 4-bit by default instead of Qwen3.6 35B
goal: The model Ask runs on by default is Qwen3.8 27B, 4-bit (Q4_K_M), a newer model than the Qwen3.6 35B used today. The older models stay as choices in Settings.
notes: User, 2026-10-24: 'we should be using qwen 3.8 27b 4 bit quant over 3.6 35b'. Checked on Hugging Face by the intake window: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B was released 2026-08-05, Apache 2.0, image-text-to-text. The official GGUFs at ggml-org/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF are Q4_K_M 18.97 GB, Q8_0 28.6 GB, BF16 53.8 GB, mmproj Q8_0 0.63 GB / BF16 0.93 GB, plus mtp-* and dflash-* draft files. MLX builds exist (lmstudio-community/Qwen3.8-27B-MLX-4bit) if MLX is ever used. The 2026-10-21 model bake-off (ask-runs-on-the-best-model-this-mac-can-hold-pic) compared Ollama tags only and never saw Qwen3.8. The choices are in Sources/PhotonzCore/AskBuiltInModel.swift (Qwen3.6 35B is the default at :74, recommended(memoryGigabytes:) at :109). Vendored server: build b11826 (Scripts/vendor-llama-server.sh). Not checked: whether b11826 knows Qwen3.8's architecture. Coordinate with the model choice task (settings-offers-several-ask-models-with-what-eac): this task decides the default, and that one shows the rows and ratings. Whichever runs second builds on the first.
acceptance: The built-in choices gain Qwen3.8 27B: ggml-org/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF, Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf (18.97 GB) and mmproj-Qwen3.8-27B-Q8_0.gguf (0.63 GB) for seeing pictures, pinned to a revision (a316ea527fde32c12487be7574e2db5ac2ad2a7e as of 2026-10-24) with exact byte sizes. It is the recommended default wherever it fits (the memory rule in PhotonzCore says from what Mac size, tested)

The vendored llama-server loads it, tools and pictures both working. If build b11826 cannot, update the vendored build (Scripts/vendor-llama-server.sh, pinned checksum) and say which build in the audit

Measured, not assumed: climb set and held-out set scores, median time to a result, and memory held, for Qwen3.8 27B Q4_K_M against Qwen3.6 35B, on this Mac, in a table in the audit. It ships as the default either way (the user's call). If it scores clearly worse somewhere, the audit says where and a follow-up is filed

Try the draft model the repo ships for faster answers (mtp-Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_0.gguf or dflash-Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_0.gguf, via llama-server's speculative decoding). Keep it if it speeds up time to a result without changing scores, and log the numbers either way
A Mac that already downloaded Qwen3.6 35B keeps working with it until the person picks otherwise. Settings offers the new one with its size, and the old one can be deleted
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Downloaded Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M (sha256 c600de03...) + mmproj Q8_0 (2e968a6a...) + mtp/dflash Q4_0 drafts at a316ea52. Vendored b11826 loads it (arch qwen35, same shape as Qwen3.6 27B): tool call and picture both answered right. Speed on the server bench (12.5k-token prompt): reads 103-183 tok/s, writes 5-15 tok/s; Qwen3.6 35B on the same bench reads 1046 and writes 76. b11853 (newest) measured the same (132/10.1 against 135/9.1 back to back), so b11826 stays. Drafts, 700-token svg write: none 11.9 tok/s, MTP 33.2 (510/565 accepted), DFlash 28.7 (494/612). MTP keeps prompt reading, tools and pictures; resident 25.8 GB with MTP against 22.0 without.
